records.title: Hearthweave Templehouse
records.body: The Hearthweave Templehouse is a living house of roots, glass, gold-lit instruments, warm rooms, and listening walls. It anchors the waking city and responds through quiet lantern signals.

records.title: Falka Hearthlight
records.body: Falka Hearthlight is a priestess, linguist, healer, and expedition lead. She studies Kelyran language, stonesinging, waking cities, and the signals of the Hearthweave Templehouse.

records.title: Virelya Lioreal
records.body: Virelya Lioreal carries the North-Star Flame. Her visual language uses hearth gold, white core light, copper edges, steadiness, and a living flame presence.

records.title: Third City
records.body: The Third City is a waking city with bone-white architecture, black diamond sand, rooted systems, lantern responses, and a hopeful signal returning through old stone and glass.

records.title: Kelyran Language
records.body: Kelyran is an ancient conlang influenced by Japanese, Norse, and English. It is associated with sung speech, old city memory, almost-doors, names, and translation work.

records.title: Nightwings
records.body: Nightwings are cat-bird-dragon companions with ivory, sapphire, and gold colouring. They are small, clever, social, and famous for biscuit raids around the Templehouse.

records.title: Three Moons
records.body: Terra Aeterna has three moons: a pale gold moon with rings, a green agate moon associated with forest and the deceased, and a deep mauve cracked moon.
